# Bitter espresso, answered

Bitter espresso is a common problem with simple fixes.

## Why does espresso taste bitter?

Espresso tastes bitter when the water pulls too much from the coffee, which is called over-extraction. A fine grind, a long shot and very hot water all push extraction up.

## How do I fix a bitter shot?

Grind a little coarser and stop the shot at about 36 grams of liquid. Change one setting at a time so you can taste what each change does.

### Does roast level matter?

Dark roasts taste bitter sooner because roasting has already broken down much of the coffee's acidity.

- Try a medium roast first.
- Use slightly cooler water for dark roasts.
